collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IX (161-180, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child buried a treasure shell and drew a map of it, and now has no idea where it is.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has buried treasure. It's a very good shell, wrapped in a leaf, which (subject.he/she) buried somewhere secret and then drew a map of on a piece of bark. The map has an X on it, a tree, a rock, and a wavy line that (subject) says is the sea. Today (subject) wants to dig it up. (subject.He/She) has no idea where it is.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They give up after four holes. "Maybe the treasure doesn't want to be found yet," says (friend). (subject) thinks about this. Then (subject.he/she) carefully writes on the bottom of the map: STILL THERE. (subject.He/She) keeps the map under (subject.his/her) sleeping mat. Some days (subject.he/she) takes it out just to look at it.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (friend) studies the map very seriously. They try the tree. Wrong tree. They try the rock. Wrong rock. They dig seven holes. On the eighth hole, by pure luck, (subject) finds the shell. (subject.He/She) holds it up like it's made of gold. Then, without a pause, (subject.he/she) buries it again and starts drawing a new map.
